entries.claim_boundary: For axial ell=2 Schwarzschild and real M omega in [1/2,3/4], the omitted v-phi Ricci row is an exactly propagated constraint C'=-2C/r. Its zero fibre is a six-dimensional complete formal endpoint module: four Ricci-carrier lifts plus two Einstein-kernel columns at both horizon and infinity. Phase-2 X0 is repaired by an exact transverse addition, while legacy E0=T/2 is not a complete Einstein solution. No global matching or flux claim follows.

dispersion.statement: Six exact formal columns: four carrier lifts and two complete Einstein-kernel modes, with no real pilot-interval exception.

lee_wald.statement: The repaired X0 changes the asymptotic current problem; no finite-flux phase space is promoted.

resonance.statement: The analytic n=0 and lower-singular n=1 forced horizon lift resonances have exact zero obstruction.
